note: achats auprès d'Ablecom et de Compuware en pourcentage du coût des ventes (10-Q 2024-03-31) : montants relevés dans la note des parties liées ; clients et fournisseurs significatifs désignés par lettre
quote: Purchases from Ablecom, and Compuware, related parties of the Company (see Part I, Item 1, Note 9, "Related Party Transactions") accounted for a combined 4.0% and 8.3% of total cost of sales for the three months ended March 31, 2024 and 2023, respectively, and a combined 4.4% and 7.0% of total cost of sales for the nine months ended March 31, 2024 and 2023, respectively.
